As a Commissioning Engineer Laser Machines, you are responsible for commissioning our laser machines at customer locations worldwide. You work with advanced fiber laser cutting machines and automated laser solutions that are a critical part of the customer's production process. Depending on the project, you work independently or together with one or two colleagues on site. From the project kick-off onwards, you analyse the customer's production process and translate this into the optimal machine setup. You are involved until final handover and acceptance. Besides technical expertise, communication plays an important role, as you guide and train operators to use the machines safely and efficiently.
